title: Kubernetes Volumes: emptyDir, PersistentVolumes & Dynamic Provisioning
description: Master Kubernetes storage: ephemeral emptyDir pod-sharing, static hostPath PV/PVC bindings with node verification, and dynamic StorageClass provisioning

steps.title: 3. Mount hostPath Volume & Verify Node Filesystem

terminals.name: monitor
terminals.foreground: until [ -f .kube/config ]; do sleep 1; done; clear; watch -n 1 'echo "=== PODS ==="; kubectl get pods; echo ""; echo "=== PVC ==="; kubectl get pvc -o custom-columns="NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,VOLUME:.spec.volumeName,CAPACITY:.spec.resources.requests.storage"; echo ""; echo "=== PV ==="; kubectl get pv -o custom-columns="NAME:.metadata.name,STATUS:.status.phase,CAPACITY:.spec.capacity.storage,CLAIM:.spec.claimRef.name"'
